template.humanGate: Praxis Admin publishes the template and independent authors/reviewers approve task revisions. Anvil qualifies execution separately. State-charter/legal applicability and application expectations require human review; no fabricated approvals.
template.primaryWork: Investigate one assigned consumer deposit application, all parties and available documents through permitted Anvil tools; submit one evidence-backed four-way recommendation.
template.verificationCriteria: 20 checks at5points each, explicit5/2/0anchors, full100pointdenominator, critical failure override. Anvil evaluates sealed state, recommendation, policy, trace and independent expectations; missing legal/human qualification stays unscored.
